title: Figrin D'an
description: As the leader the all-Bith band "the Modal Nodes," Figrin D'an was known for his deft Kloo Horn skills. Known to some as "Fiery" Figrin, he had quite a reputation and was behind one of the most recognizable tunes in Mos Eisley. They were playing their most popular song when they were interrupted by a guy with a Lightsaber but quickly got back into the jam like nothing happened.
